15.9.1 WIDGET Statement

WIDGET [FAST | SLOW] widget_name
    [WITH option_list]

The WIDGET statement creates a widget. See Gadgets.

Note

Widgets are fictional.

Names text alpha.

# not a heading, just a shell comment
$> widget --list
